entry.title: Can't focus for long? 3 fixes from 3 books
entry.summary: 3 nonfiction books, 3 different reasons your focus breaks, and 1 thing to try today from each: Deep Work, Indistractable and Digital Minimalism.

entry.title: Overthink everything? 3 fixes from 3 books
entry.summary: 3 ways nonfiction books tackle overthinking, and 1 thing to try today from each: Meditations, The Obstacle Is the Way and Four Thousand Weeks.

entry.title: Overspend every month? 3 fixes from 3 books
entry.summary: 3 money books, 3 ways to stop overspending, and 1 thing to try today from each: I Will Teach You to Be Rich, The Psychology of Money and Your Money or Your Life.

entry.title: Start strong, then quit? 3 fixes from 3 books
entry.summary: 3 habit books, 3 reasons a strong start fades, and 1 thing to try today from each: Tiny Habits, Atomic Habits and The Power of Habit.

entry.title: Deep Work: which parts to read
entry.summary: Read rules 1, 2 and 4, skim the rest. Part 1 argues for focus at length; Part 2 tells you how to do it.

entry.title: Indistractable: which parts to read
entry.summary: Read parts 1, 2 and 4. They hold the whole method; the rest applies it to work, kids and relationships.

entry.title: Digital Minimalism: which parts to read
entry.summary: Read chapters 3, 4 and 6. The declutter plus what to fill the time with.

entry.title: Meditations: which parts to read
entry.summary: Start with Books 2, 4, 5 and 8. The other books repeat the same ideas in new words, which is the point, but not where to start.

entry.title: The Obstacle Is the Way: which parts to read
entry.summary: Read Parts 1 and 2. They turn Stoicism into a method: see clearly, then act.

entry.title: Four Thousand Weeks: which parts to read
entry.summary: Read the introduction, chapters 1, 2, 4 and 7, and the 10 tools at the end. That's the whole argument plus what to do with it.

entry.title: The Psychology of Money: which parts to read
entry.summary: Read 6 of the 20 short chapters. They hold the ideas that change how you spend and save.

entry.title: I Will Teach You to Be Rich: which parts to read
entry.summary: Read chapters 4, 5 and 6 wherever you live. Much of the rest is built around US banks, cards and accounts.

entry.title: Your Money or Your Life: which parts to read
entry.summary: Do steps 2, 3, 4 and 8. They turn money into hours of your life, which changes how small buys feel.

entry.title: The Power of Habit: which parts to read
entry.summary: Read chapters 1 to 5 and the appendix. The rest is about companies and social movements: good stories, less to use.

entry.title: Tiny Habits: which parts to read
entry.summary: Read chapters 1, 3, 4 and 5. They hold the whole method; the rest grows it and applies it to bad habits and groups.
